title: Have you ever seen a UFO in real life
content: I feel so kooky asking this in a dream sub that is already a little "out there". But I had a very boring UFO encounter back in 2017. Just a light moving in ways that seemed defy physics, moved like those Tik Tak videos. Anyway, I thought maybe I'd ask if anyone else there has seen a UFO? Or had any other sort of paranormal encounter.
